record.paper_title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
record.original_question: For a smooth hypersurface in standard symplectic space, how restrictive is the condition that all of its characteristic curves are planar?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\mathbb{R}^{2n}, \omega_0)$ denote the standard symplectic vector space with $\omega_0 = \sum_{i=1}^n dx_i \wedge dy_i$, and let $S \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ be a smooth closed hypersurface. The characteristic line bundle of $S$ is the rank-one subbundle $\mathcal{L}_S \subset TS$ defined fiberwise by $\mathcal{L}_S(p) = \ker(\omega_0|_{T_pS})$, and the integral curves of $\mathcal{L}_S$ are called the characteristic curves of $S$. A curve in $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ is said to be planar if its image is contained in a 2-dimensional affine plane.

Determine how restrictive the condition "every characteristic curve of $S$ is planar" is on the hypersurface $S$. More precisely, classify (or otherwise characterize) all smooth closed hypersurfaces $S \subset (\mathbb{R}^{2n}, \omega_0)$ with $n \geq 2$ all of whose characteristic curves are planar.
artifact.status_search_result: No specific resolution of the question of classifying smooth hypersurfaces in standard symplectic space whose characteristic curves are all planar was located. Related literature studies characteristic foliations on hypersurfaces in projective symplectic manifolds and algebraicity of leaves, but does not appear to settle the planarity restriction in the linear symplectic setting.

status_evidence.title: Characteristic foliation on a hypersurface of general type in a projective symplectic manifold
status_evidence.snippet: The symplectic form induces a rank-1 characteristic foliation on a non-singular hypersurface; studies when leaves are algebraic.
status_evidence.claim: Related work concerns algebraicity of characteristic foliations, not the planarity question over standard symplectic space.

status_evidence.title: Characteristic foliation on hypersurfaces with positive Beauville-Bogomolov-Fujiki square
status_evidence.snippet: Continues investigation of characteristic foliations on symplectic hypersurfaces.
status_evidence.claim: No statement about planarity of characteristic curves in standard symplectic space.
